items.name: panel_daily
items.description: 个股日线 + hfq 复权价（视图 v_daily_hfq）+ 成交量/成交额
items.sql: SELECT d.ts_code, d.trade_date, d.open_hfq, d.high_hfq, d.low_hfq, d.close_hfq, d."close" AS close_raw, d.pre_close, d.vol, d.amount, d.pct_chg FROM v_daily_hfq d JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT con_code AS ts_code FROM index_weight WHERE index_code='000300.SH' AND trade_date BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2021-01-29') u ON d.ts_code = u.ts_code WHERE d.trade_date BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2021-01-29' ORDER BY d.ts_code, d.trade_date

items.name: panel_stk_limit
items.description: 涨跌停价（up_limit/down_limit），仅用于回测可成交判定，不进模型特征
items.sql: SELECT s.ts_code, s.trade_date, s.up_limit, s.down_limit FROM stk_limit s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT con_code AS ts_code FROM index_weight WHERE index_code='000300.SH' AND trade_date BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2021-01-29') u ON s.ts_code = u.ts_code WHERE s.trade_date BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2021-01-29' ORDER BY s.ts_code, s.trade_date

items.name: panel_suspend
items.description: 停复牌事件（suspend_d），仅用于可成交判定与标签有效性
items.sql: SELECT s.ts_code, s.trade_date, s.suspend_type, s.suspend_timing FROM suspend_d s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT con_code AS ts_code FROM index_weight WHERE index_code='000300.SH' AND trade_date BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2021-01-29') u ON s.ts_code = u.ts_code WHERE s.trade_date BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2021-01-29' ORDER BY s.ts_code, s.trade_date

items.name: panel_index_weight
items.description: 沪深300 成分权重月末快照（PIT 成分来源）
items.sql: SELECT index_code, con_code, trade_date, weight FROM index_weight WHERE index_code='000300.SH' AND trade_date BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2021-01-29' ORDER BY trade_date, con_code

items.name: panel_stock_basic
items.description: 股票主档（含 list_date，用于上市满 60 个交易日过滤）
items.sql: SELECT b.ts_code, b.name, b.list_date, b.market FROM stock_basic b JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT con_code AS ts_code FROM index_weight WHERE index_code='000300.SH' AND trade_date BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2021-01-29') u ON b.ts_code = u.ts_code ORDER BY b.ts_code
